d: Pradhanmantri narendr modi karnatak ke daure par hain, jahan unhonne bengluru men prashanti kutiram ke svarn jayanti samaroh men hissa liya. is dauran pradhanmantri kaee vikas pariyojnaon ki saugat denge. vahin, maisuru men desh ke pahle elaeedi dom taramandal ka udghatan bhi karenge. idhar, lok aastha ka mahaparv chhath nahay-khay ke sath shuru ho gaya hai. char dinon tak chalne vale is mahaparv men vibhinn paranprik anushthan kie jaenge. chhath ko lekar jharkhand ke alag-alag shahron men bajaron men raunak barh gaee hai, vahin chhath ghaton par saph-saphaee aur any vyavasthaon ko antim…
